caching.method: the port's withTtlCache (memory Map + host store, 1h TTL, in-flight de-dup) around a timestamp loader

render-modes.method: routes/feature-tests/render-modes/_middleware.ts: per-route Cache-Control (s-maxage / swr / no-store) + in-process HTML cache
render-modes.evidence: static: same timestamp twice, "public, max-age=0, s-maxage=31536000"; isr: same within 3s then re-rendered after 3.5s, "public, max-age=0, s-maxage=3, stale-while-revalidate=86400"; ssr: new timestamp each request, "private, no-store". No build-time prerender: "static" is rendered on first request and held in memory
